entries.t: 中海油16MW张力腿浮式风电平台“海油安澜号”完成生产集成
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/风电
entries.as: 中国海油自主研发的全球首座单机容量最大16MW张力腿浮式风电平台海油安澜号在珠海完成集成出港，赴粤东陆丰油田群海域。平台总高307米、重近8000吨，采用张力腿技术经9根钢缆锚定深海，设计寿命25年，年均发电5400万千瓦时，年减碳约3.5万吨，绿电经海底电缆直供油田群。
entries.b: 6月28日，据央视报道，由中国海油自主研发的全球首座单机容量最大的16MW张力腿浮式风电平台“海油安澜号”，在珠海高栏港完成一体化集成后顺利出港，正式向粤东陆丰油田群海域进发。文中称，该平台总高307米、总重近8000吨，采用张力腿（TLP）技术通过9根钢缆向下锚定深海，设计寿命为连续运行25年；投运后年均发电量可达5400万千瓦时，每年减少二氧化碳排放约3.5万吨，节约燃料油约1.5万立方米。该平台所发绿电将通过海底电缆直接接入油田群电。

entries.t: 中海油全球首座单机容量最大的TLP浮式风电平台迎来重大突破
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/风电
entries.as: 中海油全球首座单机容量最大的TLP(张力腿)浮式风电平台取得重大技术突破。TLP浮式基础是深远海风电开发的关键技术方案，相比半潜式和单柱式具有更好的深水适应性和运动稳定性。该项目采用超大单机容量风电机组，代表了浮式风电向大功率、深远海发展的技术趋势。突破涉及平台结构设计、系泊系统和动态电缆等核心技术，对推动中国深远海风电规模化开发和海洋工程装备升级具有重要意义。
kp: 平台类型[浮式风电]: TLP张力腿平台
地位[TLP浮式风电]: 全球单机容量最大
entries.b: 中海油全球首座单机容量最大的TLP浮式风电平台迎来重大突破 原创 龙吸水 龙吸水 深远海风电 2026年6月28日据央视报道，全球首座单机容量最大的张力腿（TLP）浮式风电平台“海油安澜号”已于2026年6月27日完成一体化集成，并于28日从珠海高栏港顺利出港，正式向粤东陆丰油田群海域进发。这是该平台建设历程中的关键里程碑，标志着项目从陆地建造阶段正式转入海上安装与投运阶段。 “海油安澜号”由中国海油旗下海洋石油工程股份有限公司自主研发，是我国首个应用张力腿（TLP）技术的深远海风电示范工程。该平台自2025年起进入加速建造阶段。2026年2月，据国资委官网报道显示，平台浮体部分已完成分段预制，进入总装集成的冲刺阶段。2026年3月，中国海油海油工程青岛建造场地正在加紧打造平台底座，该底座将通过9根钢缆向下锚定深海，向上托举超过200米的风机。2026年6月27日，“海油安澜号”在珠海高栏港完成一体化集成。 根据央视新闻及多家媒体报道，2026年6月27日，“海油安澜号”在珠海高栏港完成一体化集成后，由珠海海事部门护送，顺利出港。这座总高逾307米、总重近8000吨的“海上大风车”正式向粤东陆丰油田群海域进发。此次出港标志着我国深远海浮式风电技术正从示范应用加速向商业化迈进。平台后续将进行海上安装和并网运行，并为深远海油气开发提供绿色电力，实现深远海油气绿色低碳开发。 该“海上大风车”平台总高逾307米、总重近8000吨，张力腿（TLP）浮式风电平台通过9根钢缆向下锚定深海，风机平台设计寿命为连续运行25年。平台投运后，年均发电量可达5400万千瓦时，每年可减少二氧化碳排放约3.5万吨，每年节约燃料油约1.5万立方米。所发绿电将通过海底电缆直接接入油田群电网，与油气生产实现深度耦合，开创了“深远海风电+油田开发”协同减碳的全新路径。这一模式不仅直接减少了海上油田作业的碳排放，更有力推动我国深远海浮式风电技术从跟随到引领的突破。 深远海风电技术的重要突破。“海油安澜号”是全球首座单机容量最大的张力腿浮式风电平台，其成功出港标志着我国在张力腿浮式风电技术领域实现了从跟跑到领跑的跨越。张力腿技术作为深远海风电的核心技术路线之一，能够有效应对高盐、高湿、浪涌及年均十余次台风的极端考验。 “深远海风电+油田开发”协同减碳的创新模式。平台所发绿电将通过海底电缆直接接入油田群电网，与油气生产实现深度耦合。这一模式开创了海上风电与海洋油气融合发展的新路径，在全球范围内率先实现了海上风电与海洋油气的协同发展。值得注意的是，此前我国首座深远海浮式风电平台“海油观澜号”已成功验证了这一模式的可行性。截至2025年11月，“海油观澜号”年度累计发电量突破2200万千瓦时，风机年可利用率高达99.94%。 拉动海上浮式风电产业链集聚升级。“海油安澜号”的建造与出港有力拉动了海上浮式风电产业链在珠三角的集聚与升级，为培育海洋新质生产力、构建清洁低碳安全高效的能源体系贡献了“海油方案”。 ### 深远海风电公众号简评： “海油安澜号”顺利出港是我国深远海浮式风电发展进程中具有标志性意义的事件。首先它实现了张力腿浮式风电技术从理论研究到工程实践的关键跨越；其次，再次在我国粤东海域验证了“风电+油气”协同减碳模式的商业化可行性；此外为我国深远海风电的大规模开发提供了重要的技术储备和工程经验。 “海油安澜号”接下来的海上安装、调试和并网运行将是检验其技术成熟度和商业可行性的关键环节。本项目在张力腿技术应用、深远海环境适应性、油气田电网接入（海上微电网）等方面的实践经验，具有重要的参考价值和借鉴意义。小编将持续关注其海上安装进展及后续运行数据，为粉丝们及时提供最新最全面的的一手资讯。 特别声明：以上信息均来自网络公开信息整理，出于传递更多信息而非盈利之目的，同时并不代表本平台的观点，内容仅供参考。若有侵权，请联系我们删除。 修改于

entries.as: 一项研究表明，来自中国的商业化钠离子电池在制造质量与性能上已可与特斯拉的锂电池相媲美。在对比测试中，该钠电池在能量密度、循环寿命和一致性等方面表现优异，成本与安全性优势突出，显示钠离子电池技术正快速追赶锂电，有望在储能和低成本电动车领域形成有竞争力的替代方案。

entries.b:
A new study found that a commercial sodium-ion battery from China rivals Tesla’s batteries in manufacturing quality and several key performance benchmarks.
With improvements to cold-weather charging and energy density, sodium-ion batteries could become a more affordable alternative for electric vehicles and grid-scale energy storage.
A commercially available sodium-ion battery already being used in cars and large-scale energy storage systems in China has achieved manufacturing quality and performance levels comparable to Tesla’s lithium-ion batteries, according to research published in the Cell Press journal
Cell Reports
Physical Science
The findings suggest sodium-ion technology is advancing faster than many expected. Although the battery still needs improvements in cold-weather charging and energy density, researchers believe it could become a lower-cost alternative for future electric vehicles by replacing lithium with sodium, an abundant and widely available material.
“The combination of good uniformity, high power capability, and strong low‑temperature performance makes these cells attractive for stationary storage, grid services, and shorter‑range or commercial vehicles where potential lower cost and resource availability matter more than maximum driving range,” says Moritz Schütte, a battery researcher at RWTH Aachen University in Germany.
To evaluate how Hina’s sodium-ion batteries stack up against Tesla’s more advanced lithium-ion cells, Schütte and his colleagues analyzed 120 battery cells using a non-destructive method known as impedance spectroscopy to measure manufacturing consistency.
The team also tested each battery under realistic operating conditions, measuring power and energy performance across a range of charging currents and temperatures from −20 °C to 45 °C. X-ray imaging allowed the researchers to examine the batteries’ internal structures before they disassembled the cells to study electrode dimensions, material composition, and microscopic features.
Their analysis revealed a sophisticated design that includes a tabless, double-aluminum current collector. This layout lowers electrical resistance, promotes more even temperature distribution, and closely resembles the architecture used in current Tesla batteries.
“We were positively surprised by how uniform the cells are,” says Schütte.
Despite its impressive performance, the sodium-ion battery still falls short of the best lithium-ion batteries in several important areas. The researchers found that while the battery delivers better high-power performance than expected for an early commercial sodium-ion product, charging at low temperatures remains a significant challenge.
“The high-power performance was better than one might expect from an early commercial sodium-ion product,” says Schütte. “However, for applications that require frequent charging at low ambient temperatures, appropriate thermal management or operating strategies will be important because low-temperature charging remains a clear weakness.”
The team also detected unexpectedly high and uneven concentrations of copper in parts of the battery’s cathode.
According to Schütte, this “raises interesting questions about its role in performance and aging,” adding, “It will be exciting to see future sodium-ion technologies that are free of nickel and copper, as well, while achieving competitive energy density.”
Sodium offers several potential advantages over lithium because it is far more abundant and easier to source worldwide. That could lower raw material costs for battery manufacturers while reducing long-term supply chain concerns.
The study also found that sodium-ion batteries maintain strong performance under heavy loads in cold conditions, making them promising candidates for stationary energy storage as well as vehicles operating in colder climates.
“However, today’s commercial sodium-ion cells generally have lower energy density than the best lithium-ion cells, and the technology is less mature overall,” said Schütte.
The researchers now plan to improve how sodium-ion batteries charge at temperatures below 0°C, with the goal of making charging both safer and more efficient in freezing conditions.
Future work will also focus on refining the materials used inside the batteries.
“Advances in hard-carbon anodes and electrolyte formulations may be especially promising,” he said.
Reference: “Cell teardown and characterization of a Hina commercial sodium-ion battery” by Christian Siebert, Moritz Schütte, Jonas Rinner, Gereon Stahl, Jan Lin, Katharina Quade, Heinrich Ditler, Christiane Rahe and Dirk Uwe Sauer, 28 May 2026,
Cell Reports Physical Science
DOI: 10.1016/j.xcrp.2026.103323
The research was supported by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology, and Space and the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy.

entries.t: ICML 2026 Oral｜大模型的能力从哪些训练数据来？北大&智源提出「机理数据归因」
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: 北京大学与智源研究院(BAAI)提出「机理数据归因」方法,获ICML 2026 Oral报告。该方法旨在追溯大语言模型(LLM)的特定能力究竟来源于哪些训练数据,而非仅依赖整体数据规模的经验性判断。通过机理分析手段,研究者建立了从模型行为到训练样本的可解释映射,为大模型训练数据的精准筛选、质量优化及能力归因提供了理论工具。该工作对理解大模型能力形成机制、构建高效数据配方具有重要意义。

entries.t: GPT5.6惨遭切脑！Fable 5回归要变弱鸡版?
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: 科技圈热议GPT5.6模型疑似遭遇能力削减（俗称'切脑'），引发关于其推理与创作能力下降的广泛讨论。同时，竞争对手Fable 5的回归版本据称也出现能力弱化迹象。该消息反映出大模型行业在算力成本、安全对齐与能力上限之间的博弈加剧，用户对模型'阉割'现象的担忧持续升温。
entries.b: GPT5.6惨遭切脑！Fable 5回归要变弱鸡版? ASI启示录 ASI启示录 新智元 ### ### **新智元报道** ##### **【新智元导读】**GPT-5.6 Sol被拆分、被按住，Fable 5被全球禁用72小时后才戴着镣铐回归。Anthropic和OpenAI最强模型，双双被「切脑」。 昨日，OpenAI最强系列GPT-5.6突然上线。 但GPT-5.6被拆分为三种形态： GPT-5.6 Sol：下一代前沿模型， GPT-5.6 Terra：适用于日常高效工作的均衡模型， GPT-5.6 Luna：面向高吞吐量任务的快速经济型模型。 但最强的GPT-5.6 Sol的发布权，已不在OpenAI的奥特曼手中，而在「获批名单」里。 在OpenAI低头之前，Anthropic刚刚经历了「封禁危机」：除部分合作机构外，Fable 5全球禁用。 **算法配给制时代，GPT5.6惨遭切脑** 以前是产品出问题了召回，这回是产品还没出门，先被拦在门口。 据该消息人士称，OpenAI被要求限制GPT-5.6的发布范围。 理由是在全美的AI安全框架落地之前，先把最强的几款摁住。 据透漏，这次介入是因为GPT-5.6具有「类似Mythos」的能力，而非突然采取更强硬的干预手段。 OpenAI三思后，决定限制了最新AI的访问权限，只有有限的用户得以预览GPT-5.6。 绝大数ChatGPT用户，仍需要几周等待GPT-5.6逐步解禁。 **Mythos 5让人害怕！Fable 5回归要变弱鸡版?** 在OpenAI低头之前，另一位巨头Anthropic刚刚经历了危机。 两周前，Anthropic发布了被神话级AI模型的**Fable 5**。 然而，这款模型在货架上仅仅存活了72小时，便遭到了暴力下架。 因为恐惧。Fable 5的网络进攻能力让人恐惧。 美国众议院议员Andrew Garbarino，如此表示。 在一次闭门演示中，Anthropic Mythos展示了惊人的软件安全界的威胁，例如它甚至可以清空私人银行账户。 Andrew Garbarino说： Anthropic指示该模型找到银行系统中的漏洞并清空账户，然后它就去执行了。 随后，Mythos「还能找到这一漏洞并修复」。 **这是一场人类史上前所未有的「拔插头」行动。** 直到最近，**Mythos 5**才在「戴着镣铐」的情况下被允许向极少数「信任伙伴」开放。 据最新报道：Mythos 5「阉割版」Fable 5预计将于下周回归并上线。 不过，Fable 5可能被严重阉割，确保安全护栏更加牢固。 Fable 5刚发布时，就有用户发现，只要说「癌症」（caner）这个单词，就被Claude拉黑了。 而如果护栏进一步加强，用户体验可能是一场噩梦。 Shopify CTO Mikhail Parakhin深度测试过Fable 5和GPT-5.6Max。 他认为，Anthropic绝对优势不在，GPT-5.6已经追了上来Claude Mythos。 GPT 5.6在各方面都明显优于 Opus 4.8（速度也稍快，不过取决于负载）。 与Fable 5相比，它在编码方面明显逊色，但在智能体工作负载上表现更佳。 这是罕见的Fable 5和GPT-5.6真实对比，但足以看出Anthropic还不能高枕无忧。 如果Fable 5回归只有阉割版，无疑留给了更多对手追赶的机会。 **你买到的是天才，还是傀儡？** 最令开发者焦虑的，不仅是「买不到」，而是「货不对板」 。 在AI圈子里，一个词正在像病毒一样蔓延：**「脑叶切除」（Lobotomized）。** 为了通过那些繁复的安全审查，AI巨头们不得不给模型装上层层加固的「护栏」。 但智能这种东西，往往产生于混沌与自由。 当你强行阉割掉一个模型在底层代码、加密算法甚至深层逻辑上的探索能力时，你得到的可能不再是一个无所不知的「Sol」，而是一个被剪掉利爪、唯唯诺诺的平庸的「Luna」。 **你想要的是「普罗米修斯的火种」，但美国只允许你拥有出口「打火机」。** 开发者普遍害怕，模型会被大幅加固护栏、甚至被「**脑叶切除**」（lobotomized），能力被阉割，严重降智。 更糟的是，它可能**仅限美国使用**，或者需要**严格的身份验证**，而不是当初承诺的「**广泛、付费即可用**」。 还有钱的问题。 Anthropic最初是在多个付费版Claude订阅里，**免费**提供Fable 5，开放到6月22日，给用户一个短暂的窗口去体验它的威力——然后，访问就消失了。 现在没人说得清：订阅用户还能不能拿回当初承诺的「免费畅用」？还是说，它回来时，已经被锁在了**额外收费**或**身份核验**的门后？ 也许不久后，我们会怀念2023年的那个

entries.t: 欧洲首台TES谱仪使此前不可能的X射线实验成为可能
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 欧洲首台TES(超导转变边沿传感器)光谱仪投入运行，灵敏度较传统设备提升最高1000倍，使此前无法实现的X射线实验成为可能。该仪器在材料科学、量子计算等前沿领域的精密能谱测量中具有突破性意义。

entries.b:
Europe’s first TES spectrometer is transforming X-ray research with up to 1,000 times greater sensitivity, making once impossible experiments finally possible.
Europe’s first and only TES spectrometer at a synchrotron light source is now operating at BESSY II, marking a major advance for X-ray research. Developed through a collaboration between HZB, the MPI-CEC (Mühlheim-an-der-Ruhr, Germany), and NIST (Boulder CO, USA), the new instrument can detect X-ray photons with an efficiency that is 100 to 1,000 times greater than conventional wavelength dispersive X-ray emission spectrometers.
Its exceptional sensitivity will allow researchers to investigate the electronic properties of atomically thin materials, nanostructures, and extremely dilute atomic and molecular samples. The team is now inviting scientists to submit research proposals that take advantage of the new capability.
Synchrotron facilities such as BESSY II generate exceptionally bright X-ray beams that scientists use to study the structure and properties of many different materials. Some of the most powerful techniques, including X-ray emission spectroscopy (XES) and Resonant Inelastic X-ray Scattering (RIXS), analyze the X-ray photons emitted by a sample after it is exposed to the beam.
These methods provide valuable information about a material’s electronic structure, but they require large numbers of emitted photons to produce meaningful data. As a result, XES and RIXS have traditionally been limited to bulk materials and samples with relatively high concentrations.
“The superconducting Transition Edge Sensor (TES) array
detector that we have now put into operation at BESSY II is around 100 to 1000 times more efficient to detect photons than conventional XES and RIXS spectrometers,” says Régis Decker, HZB, responsible scientist of the new instrument.
That dramatic improvement makes it possible to examine samples that were previously too small or too dilute for these techniques.
According to Decker, the new spectrometer will enable studies across a wide range of scientific fields.
“This can provide new insights into molecular chemistry or molecular biology, but also into the quantum properties of systems in reduced dimensions such as atomic monolayers, nanostructures, and impurities. The TES spectrometer complements methods such as ARPES, which scans the electronic band structures of such systems,” says Régis Decker.
The increased sensitivity also speeds up many experiments. Measurements that once required hours can now, in some cases, be completed within minutes.
The instrument contains an array of 248 superconducting sensors that operate at an extremely low temperature of just 25 milli-Kelvin. Those conditions are achieved using a He4-He3 dilution refrigerator, a cooling technology similar to the systems used in quantum computers.
When X-rays strike a sample, the material emits photons of its own. Each emitted photon is captured by one of the superconducting sensors, briefly raising its temperature enough to disrupt its superconducting state. That tiny change increases the sensor’s electrical resistance, which is measured using a circuit based on Superconducting Quantum Interference Devices (SQUIDs). This process allows the energy of each photon to be measured with remarkable precision.
The spectrometer is connected to a custom ultra-high vacuum sample chamber that allows researchers to transfer, prepare, and analyze samples while precisely controlling temperatures from 10 K to room temperature.
The complete system is installed at the BESSY II UE52-SGM beamline, which provides full polarisation control. Future enhancements will expand sample preparation capabilities and enable experiments in magnetic fields for X-ray Magnetic Circular Dichroism in absorption (XMCD) and emission (RIXS-MCD).
TES spectrometers were originally created for astrophysics, where they were designed to detect extremely weak photon signals from distant objects.
Before the installation at BESSY II, only five TES spectrometers were operating at X-ray facilities worldwide, with four located in the United States and one in Japan. BESSY II now hosts the only synchrotron TES spectrometer in Europe.
“We are looking forward to receiving exciting research proposals from our user community,” says Decker.
Reference: “A superconducting transition edge sensor array for synchrotron soft x-ray emission spectroscopies of low-dimensional and impurity-level concentration systems” by Régis Decker, Kelsey M. Morgan, Sergey Peredkov, Charles J. Titus, Galen C. O’Neil, Alexander Dillmann, Dmitry Tikhonov, Utkarsh Prakash, Axel Knop-Gericke, Joseph W. Fowler, Jonathan W. Dean, Nathan Nakamura, Raoul Blume, Detre Techner, Minmin Chen, Zechao Jin, Christian Weniger, Thomas Blume, Torsten Kachel, Nathan J. Ortiz, Douglas A. Bennett, John A. B. Mates, Daniel R. Schmidt, Jozsef Imrek, Joel C. Weber, Johnathon D. Gard, Leila Vale, Abigail L. Wessels, Bastian Klemke, Sebastian Gerischer, Mattis Fondell, Sebastian Eckert, Joel N. Ullom, Daniel S. entries.t: 梅赛德斯发布媲美特斯拉的能效：36吨卡车穿越德国冬季
entries.c: 通用技术/通信和运输/陆路运输
entries.as: 梅赛德斯重型电动卡车在德国冬季条件下实现接近特斯拉的能效表现，拖载36吨货物完成实测。该结果打破了业界关于重型电动商用车在低温环境下能耗高、续航差的固有偏见，验证了重型电动卡车在实际运营场景中的工程成熟度。

Despite the rapidly growing number of heavy-duty EVs on western roads, a number of myths still persist about range, charging infrastructure, and economic viability. To combat those myths, Mercedes-Benz is sharing real-world data from 80 of its deployed electric semi trucks. Here’s what they found.
The data released by Mercedes-Benz covers 80 battery-electric heavy trucks deployed in the company’s own logistics fleet over thousands of trips, thousands of charging cycles,
and millions of miles
. Their conclusion:
electric long‑haul transport is viable today
A real‑world example from the Ulm‑based logistics company Seifert illustrates a route between Wörth am Rhein and Bielefeld. An eActros 600 with an average gross combination weight of 36 metric tons achieves a daily mileage of around 600 km, with approximately half of the charging events taking place at public charging points. On this route, the electric truck also achieves toll savings of more than €4,000/mo. Annually, this route saves 90 metric tons of CO2e. Average energy consumption between November and February is 100 kWh per 100 km, which is equivalent to approximately 11 liters of diesel.
The data demonstrate that demanding long‑distance routes can already be operated reliably and predictably on this route using today’s public charging infrastructure and economically as well, when TCO is considered.
MERCEDES-BENZ
Those results mirror previous studies from groups like
Transport Canada
, which followed Class 8 electric trucks across a year of North American operations, and further support the idea that battery powered logistics are ready for prime time,
saving commercial vehicle fleets both time
… under the right circumstances.
The report repeatedly shows that success depended less on vehicle capability than on operational alignment. Routes with predictable distances, centralized terminals and controlled return schedules allowed electric trucks to operate efficiently and reliably, while variability and scheduling pressure quickly exposed operational flaws.
Interestingly, too, Mercedes-Benz’ operational data shows its cabover-style eActros trucks achieving an impressive 1.61 kWh / mile efficiency while rolling out at an
of 36 metric tons (~79,400 lbs.) combined vehicle weight.
That number compares
favorably to the Tesla Semi team’s claimed 1.55 kWh / mile efficiency
. It should also be noted that ArcBest,
the logistics company operating the Tesla Semi prototypes that recorded those numbers
, is traditionally an LTL, or “
less-than-truckload
” freight carrier, and did not reveal the average combined vehicle weight of the loads it was running when its trucks recorded that 1.55 kWh / mile number.
Mercedes’ number, for what its worth, was achieved under heavy loads and in cold weather (between Novemeber and February), while the ArcBest numbers were recorded on routes between Reno, Nevada, and Sacramento, California – which get cold enough, but are hardly comparable to a German winter.
All of which is to say that, regardless of which electric semi truck your fleet eventually chooses to deploy, it might be a lot more efficient –
and save you a lot more money
– than you might think.

entries.t: 电致伸缩驱动的相不稳定性使Hf0.5Zr0.5O2实现巨大赝压电效应
entries.a: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
entries.c: 通用技术/材料工程/其它先进材料
entries.as: 铪锆氧化物（HZO）的铁电及电机械性能长期未被充分探索。本研究发现电致伸缩驱动的相变不稳定性可产生巨准压电效应，为无铅压电材料和新型铁电器件设计提供了全新物理机制，在存储器、传感器与执行器领域具有应用前景。
kp: 临界电场[HZO外延薄膜]: 24 kV/cm
[赝压电]: 电致伸缩驱动相不稳定性产生巨响应
entries.b:
The electromechanical properties of hafnium zirconium oxide fluorite (Hf
                    0.5
                    Zr
                    0.5
                    O
                    2
                    , HZO) remain largely unexplored despite its widespread use as a ferroelectric in CMOS-compatible devices. Here, we demonstrate that electrostriction-driven phase instability enables a giant pseudo-piezoelectric response in epitaxial HZO thin films. Above a critical field of 24 kilovolts per centimeter, field-induced transitions between nonpolar and polar phases activate an extrinsic piezoelectric response of ~1000 picometers per volt and bias-stabilized pseudo-piezoelectric strains exceeding 10,000 picometers per volt. This behavior arises from a combination of large electrostriction (
                    M
                     = 1 × 10
                    −14
                     square meters per square volt), ferroelastic softness, and structural reconfiguration, rather than intrinsic polarization switching. Multimodal characterization combining interferometry, diffraction methods, scanning probe microscopy, and first-principles modeling confirms the coupling between strain and metastable phase dynamics. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized mechanism for functional strain generation in fluorite oxides, positioning HZO as a versatile platform for strain-engineered actuators, adaptive metasurfaces, and reconfigurable nanoelectromechanical systems.
